hotspots.title: Adorni scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: Manuel Adorni, former Chief of Staff under Javier Milei, faces allegations of illicit enrichment after spending $139 million on credit cards, far exceeding his declared income. Multiple witnesses have testified about his use of others' credit cards for luxury purchases, complicating his legal situation and casting a shadow over Milei's administration.
hotspots.affect: This scandal commands disproportionate attention due to its moral outrage and perceived hypocrisy, as Adorni was a key figure in Milei's anti-corruption platform.

hotspots.title: Vox blocks Andalusian investiture
hotspots.blurb: Vox is leveraging its parliamentary power to demand key concessions from the PP in Andalusia, threatening to block Juanma Moreno's investiture unless their conditions are met. The negotiations have stalled over Vox's demands for specific ministries and policy changes, creating a high-stakes political showdown.
hotspots.affect: The standoff is charged due to its high-stakes nature, with Vox's aggressive bargaining tactics and the potential for new elections if no agreement is reached.

hotspots.title: AfD ban debate intensifies
hotspots.blurb: Germany's AfD faces growing scrutiny and potential bans as it holds its federal party conference in Erfurt. Protests, legal challenges, and internal divisions dominate coverage, with critics accusing the party of extremism and constitutional violations.
hotspots.affect: The debate is highly charged due to the perceived threat to democratic norms, with mass protests and legal actions framing the AfD as a danger to Germany's political system.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen's eligibility crisis
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen faces a critical court ruling on July 7 that could determine her eligibility for the 2027 French presidential election. The case revolves around her alleged misuse of EU funds, with potential consequences including ineligibility and fines.
hotspots.affect: This story commands attention due to its high stakes for Le Pen's political future and the broader implications for France's far-right movement, with intense moral and legal framing.

hotspots.title: Tisza surges as Fidesz collapses
hotspots.blurb: Hungary's political landscape is shifting dramatically as Péter Magyar's Tisza party surges in polls, while Viktor Orbán's Fidesz faces unprecedented declines. The new government is implementing sweeping changes, including media reforms and economic policies, amid growing public support.
hotspots.affect: The rapid political shift commands attention due to its dramatic nature and the perceived end of Orbán's long-standing dominance, with intense framing around Hungary's democratic future.
